**Fuel Assessment**

- **Settings:** Select the Fuel Assessment tool settings​​

- **Fuel Estimate:** View the Fuel Assessment page​

- **BioSAF:** The Bio SAF Fuel production, units, ​electricity required, GHGs, cost & ​Minimum Selling Price​

- **SAF Coproduct:** Assess the SAF Coproducts production​

- **Synthetic SAF:** The Synthetic SAF fuel production, electricity required, units GHGs, Costs, Levelised Cost, Minimum Selling Price​, Market Price, Delivered Price

- **Electric Aircraft:** The Electric Aircraft electricity production​

- **Hydrogen Aircraft:** The Hydrogen fuel production ​

- **Allocated Renewable Electricity:** Assess the volume of Green electricity (produced with renewable energy) necessary ​for Fuel production

- **Electricity Share:** Display Global, Allocated & Used electricity

- **Fill the Renewable Electricity Gap:** Plan the Renewable electricity infrastructures to fill the Renewable electricity gap with costs​

- **Allocated Low-Carbon Electricity:** Assess the Low-Carbon electricity necessary for Fuel production

- **Fill the Low Carbon Electricity Gap:** Plan the Low-Carbon electricity infrastructures to fill the Low-Carbon electricity gap with costs​

- **Allocated Other Electricity:​** Assess the Others energy category of electricity necessary ​for Fuel production

- **Needs​&​Production:** View needs & production chart ​(SAF, Hydrogen fuel and Electric aircraft)​

- **SAF & H2 Costs:** Graph​Graphical display of SAF and H2 costs​for each feedstock/pathway​
